description: Ivorian Air Force Puma standing on the open display lawn on the FACI side of Abidjan Félix-Houphouët-Boigny, roughly 60 m east of the Dauphin. Construction number 1044. Recorded as preserved by the Spottingmode Wrecks and Relics contributor database; a helicopter with rotors spread is visible at this exact point on Esri WorldView-2 imagery acquired 15 March 2025, on grass with no taxiway connection.

Small white helicopter on its own fenced grass plot about 60 m west of the Puma and Broussard group at the Abidjan air base. Construction number 5029. Listed as preserved with a May 2025 update; visible at the recorded coordinate on 15 March 2025 Esri imagery.

High-wing braced monoplane with a large cruciform tail sitting on the same Abidjan air base display lawn as the Puma, about 40 m to its north. No serial could be established and none is recorded, so tail_number is left blank. Identified as an MH.1521 in the Spottingmode location description and matching that planform on 15 March 2025 Esri imagery. Côte d'Ivoire operated seven Broussards, which were MH.1521M, but the source gives no variant for this airframe so the field is left blank.
